pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with sharp, linear pixel gradients on the lower flank; on the dorsal region, patches are obscured by raised, dark, irregular nodular masses with high textural rugosity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored pathways forming a continuous grid on the lower flank with clear tri-junction nodes; pathways become narrow, fragmented, and occluded by dark nodules on the upper flank and dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth silhouette formed by dark, coarse hair clusters along the upper neck and shoulder line.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Multiple structural breaks and height variations in the mane line where the hair base is interrupted by large cutaneous nodules.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive, high-density distribution of raised, hyper-pigmented, and texturally disrupted nodules covering the dorsal ridge and upper lateral surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive clusters of raised, rugose cutaneous lesions (potentially parasitic or disease-related) covering roughly 40 percent of the visible upper body surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the upper neck region, interacting with the skin surface.
